summary: @servicetitan/stylelint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`math_init.js`) shipped at the tarball root. The payload uses a shuffled string-array obfuscator (`WV8StW` rotator over constant array `n7gIxM`) and randomized identifiers, and is executed under an alternate runtime that is not inspected by Node-based tooling. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` sit outside the declared `package.json` `files` manifest (`["dist", "src"]`) and are unrelated to the stated purpose of the package (a stylelint configuration whose legitimate entry is `./dist/index.js`), consistent with smuggled files inserted through a compromise or malicious republish rather than the author's normal build output. Installing this version causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
